const key = Symbol('key');
function inspectObject(value: object) {
  if (key in value) console.log(value[key]);
}
function inspectSymbol(value: {[key]: number} | {other: string}) {
  if (key in value) console.log(value[key].toFixed(1));
  else console.log(value.other.toUpperCase());
}
function inspectOptional(value: {[key]?: number} | {other: string}) {
  if (key in value && value[key] !== undefined) console.log(value[key].toFixed(1));
}
type Result = {kind: 'ok'; value: string} | {kind: 'error'; value: Error};
const kind = 'kind';
function brackets(value: Result) {
  if (value['kind'] === 'ok') console.log(value.value.toUpperCase());
  else console.log(value.value.message);
  if (value[kind] !== 'error') console.log(value.value.toUpperCase());
  switch (value['kind']) {
    case 'ok': console.log(value.value.toLowerCase()); break;
    case 'error': console.log(value.value.message); break;
  }
}
const zero = 0;
function tuple(value: ['ok', string] | ['error', Error]) {
  if (value[0] === 'ok') console.log(value[1].toUpperCase());
  if (value[zero] === 'error') console.log(value[1].message);
}
type Combined = {id: number} & ({kind: 'ok'; value: string} | {kind: 'error'; value: Error});
function combined(value: Combined) {
  if (value.kind === 'ok') console.log(value.id, value.value.toUpperCase());
  else console.log(value.value.message);
}
type Separate = ({kind: 'ok'} & {value: string}) | ({kind: 'error'} & {value: Error});
function separate(value: Separate) {
  if (value['kind'] === 'ok') console.log(value.value.toUpperCase());
}
type SymbolTagged = ({[key]: 'ok'} & {value: string}) | ({[key]: 'error'} & {value: Error});
function symbolTagged(value: SymbolTagged) {
  if (value[key] === 'ok') console.log(value.value.toUpperCase());
}
inspectObject({[key]: 3});
inspectSymbol({[key]: 2});
inspectSymbol({other: 'other'});
inspectOptional({[key]: 4});
brackets({kind: 'ok', value: 'hello'});
tuple(['ok', 'tuple']);
tuple(['error', new Error('bad')]);
combined({id: 1, kind: 'ok', value: 'combined'});
separate({kind: 'ok', value: 'separate'});
symbolTagged({[key]: 'ok', value: 'symbol'});

function indexed(value: {[k: symbol]: number} | {other: string}) {
  if(key in value) console.log(value[key].toFixed(1));
}
indexed({[key]: 5});
function optionalReceiver(value: Result | undefined) {
  if (value?.['kind'] === 'ok') console.log(value.value.toUpperCase());
}
optionalReceiver({kind: 'ok', value: 'optional'});
function templateKeys(value: Result) {
  if (value[`kind`] === 'ok') console.log(value.value.toUpperCase());
  if (value[`ki\u006ed`] === 'ok') console.log(value.value.toLowerCase());
}
templateKeys({kind: 'ok', value: 'template'});
